verdict.rationale: Phaser's docs and community feedback confirm sprites, scenes, arcade physics, animations, tilemaps/atlases, and input are core, well-documented primitives rather than bolted-on features, and community comments reinforce it as a dedicated 2D engine (comparisons to Pixi/Love2D, 'fits 2D, sprites, tilemaps, physics'). missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of tilemap-specific workflows and no explicit dedicated tilemap doc excerpt in the pack (only physics/scenes/animations/input are directly quoted).
